description: T-4342: a hold-out for T-4241's GROUPBY tree model on intransitive runs (A = ab, B = ab&U+00AD, C = U+00AD&ab; A = C = B, A < B). Rows 1-30: seeded five-row runs, two fields; rows 31-50: three fields (text, x/y, text); rows 51-56: ASCII case spellings beside x/y. B: GROUPBY ascending, ARRAYTOTEXT of the member positions; C: sort_order -1; D: SUM of 2^(position-1); E: PIVOTBY by a p/q column field, no totals. Written with the model's predictions (docs/research/t4342) before the fill.
